rationale: Depends on PR #22. Extend the planned artifact `docs/system/qst_stor_0002_thermal_loss_evidence_checklist.md` so candidate coatings and interfaces report environmental exposure basis, degraded values, uncertainty, and transfer limits. Success requires every candidate to distinguish measured fact from extrapolation and assess whether effective emissivity <= 0.10 and parasitic conductance <= 5e-5 W/K remain credible after vacuum, radiation, contamination, and thermal-cycling margins. Supporting evidence: EVID-20260719T145804000000Z-space-weather-margin-6d1eb98b2888c55d1f62. Priority effect: none.
